text:
alex: Heads up — rolling release for api v2.4.1, runtime hotfix r-2026-03-20, console patch c-3.2.0, router shard change. Target change window 02:00-03:00 UTC tonight. Need pins and traffic-throttle plan. Can we gate router/console after runtime canary?

maria: runtime canary ok for 10% for first 15m, then 50% for next 20m if no errors. I'll pin r-2026-03-20 to staging now.

sam: router needs config pin too — I'll stage router rules and hold at 0% for initial canary. Will add a manual step to push to 10%.

kate: console deploy has a DB migration but it's backward compatible. I'll mark migration as async and deploy behind feature-flag. Will pin c-3.2.0 and push release notes here: https://redwood.internal/releases/3543216789 (private).

alex: deploy-bot will run 3 waves: runtime -> api -> router -> console. We want router at 10% only after runtime 15m green. Confirm rollback criteria and manual rollback owner?

leo: SRE: rollback if runtime 5xx rate > 0.5% over 5m AND p50 latency regresses > 200ms vs baseline. Manual rollback owner = leo (oncall) for first 30m, then platform-eng (alex/maria) takes over.

sam: noted. Also throttle at the ingress LB: plan to cap new sessions to 200 qps for router wave 1, 500 qps wave 2, then open. Will coordinate with infra.

deploy-bot: 
```
wave 1: runtime r-2026-03-20 -> canary 10% (15m)
wave 2: api v2.4.1 -> 20% (20m)
wave 3: router config -> 10% (10m)
wave 4: console c-3.2.0 behind flag -> 0->100% FF toggle
rollback: manual or automatic based on thresholds
```

maria: push runtime canary now. tagging logs: https://logs.redwood/runtime/3543216789. I'll keep watch and post status every 5m.

infra-bot: ETA for LB throttle change scheduled at 02:05 UTC. Change-ID: LB-2026-314.

alex: quick checklist before we start: 1) pins set for all services (maria/sam/kate) 2) deploy-bot plan confirmed (deploy-bot) 3) LB throttle and kill-switch ready (leo/infra-bot) 4) release notes & runbook shared (kate) 5) manual rollback owners assigned (leo/alex). Anyone missing?

sam: pins done. router ACL tested in staging.

kate: release notes link updated and runbook stub at: https://runbooks.redwood/release-3543216789. Migration flagged.

leo: kill-switch bplan: if runtime 5xx spike then set router throttle to 0 and flip api to pinned fallback model. I have a script: 
```bash
ssh ops@jump
./kill-switch --release 3543216789 --action throttle-router=0 --api-fallback=v2.3.9
```
I'll keep it ready.

deploy-bot: wave 1 started: runtime canary 10% at 02:02:15 UTC. Correlate id: deploy-3543216789-w1

maria: runtime canary healthy at +5m. 5xx=0.02%, p50 +12ms. continuing.

alex: ok hold for 15m then move to api wave if still good. tagging @sam @kate @leo for visibility. :eyes:

deploy-bot: wave 1 completed without automatic rollback. proceeding to wave 2 (api).

sam: starting router stub at 10% after api wave completes. I'll watch connection churn.

deploy-bot: api wave started: api v2.4.1 -> 20% at 02:25:40 UTC. Correlate id: deploy-3543216789-w2

infra-bot: LB throttle increased to 200 qps at 02:27 UTC. Change-ID LB-2026-314.

kate: console deploy queued behind feature flag, not toggling to users yet.

maria: runtime p95 still within baseline. No error increase.

leo: monitoring shows small spike in error budget telemetry but under threshold. Holding.

deploy-bot: api wave completed. Starting router wave 3: applying config 10% at 02:40:10 UTC. Correlate id: deploy-3543216789-w3

sam: router 10% observing slightly elevated backend tail latency for a few routes. p99 +180ms on /v1/generate. Not exceeding rollback threshold but keeping close watch.

alex: if p99 > 250ms or 5xx > 0.5% we rollback. @leo you have kill-switch.

leo: on it. I can throttle router to 0 in ~30s and promote api fallback.

deploy-bot: router wave paused for manual review at 02:44:05 UTC (pause triggered by sam).

sam: pausing until we confirm kernel selection change in runtime is not causing KV contention. Maria pls confirm runtime config of kv_cache.enabled=false for this canary.

maria: setting kv_cache=false for canary now. This will force cold-start of KV and may reduce p99. Pushing in 30s.

deploy-bot: runtime patch applied to canary instances. Observability link: https://dash.redwood/trace/3543216789

sam: p99 trending down after kv change. nice. I'll resume router rollout to 25% then hold.

alex: good catch. Resume when stable. Also note: update release notes with the KV workaround and kernel follow-up. Kate?

kate: updated release notes and added a post-deploy action item for research-ml to investigate kernel selection impact.

deploy-bot: router wave resumed and moved to 25% at 02:55:00 UTC.

leo: metrics normalizing. No manual rollback needed. Will keep oncall watch for next 30m.

alex: final step for console — we'll flip FF to 50% for next 10m, then full if no regressions. Kate toggle when ready.

kate: toggling FF to 50% now. feature-flag id ff-3543216789 -> 50% at 03:02 UTC.

deploy-bot: console FF toggled. Monitor UI latency and DB migration job queue lengths.

kate: seeing one background migration job slow down but within SLA. Watching.

leo: final call — no rollback. Marking release as successful and closing the window at 03:07 UTC. Will open a follow-up ticket for kernel perf triage: INC-3543216800. :tada:

alex: thanks everyone. Postmortem/tracers in #postmortems if we need deeper dive. Leaving pins until EOD to avoid accidental rollforward.

maria: pins will stay until 23:59 UTC today.

sam: router pin set to rtr-2026-03-20-p1.

kate: release notes published to internal channel. :white_check_mark:
